newsitem.title: UK: Shippers may get cargo rate discount information.
newsitem.headline: Shippers may get cargo rate discount information.

text.p: The UK Air Freight Forum has recommended that shippers should be told by airlines of rate discounts available outside of peak Friday/Saturday periods.
This was agreed by representatives of the Forum's 20 airline, forwarder and shipper members at its third meeting held here.

"Discounts are often available from airlines to encourage their customers to use flights outside of the traditional peak periods, avoiding congestion and under-utilisation of midweek freight capacity," said a statement issued by the Forum.
"The shipper, and sometimes the agent, appear sometimes not to know about such discounts," it said.
The statement added that giving shippers this information would help stimulate an awareness that discounts are sometimes available.
